summary: Suzano S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of its acquisition of a 51% equity interest in FamPro Tissue Holdings B.V. (Arbex) from Kimberly-Clark Corporation. The total cash consideration was USD 1.3 billion, with the joint venture assuming approximately USD 1.0 billion in net debt. The transaction was first disclosed on June 5, 2025, and closed after conditions precedent were satisfied. Suzano holds controlling shareholder status with a defined governance structure including a joint venture agreement and ancillary service and IP agreements. The price is subject to customary adjustments. Watch for the integration of Arbex's operations and potential synergies in the tissue paper market.
